explanation.text: The claim that POST counts as a safe method in the June 2022 HTTP standard is contradicted by RFC 9110, which defines POST as not safe.
RFC 9110 explicitly states that GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, and QUERY are safe methods, implying POST is not among them.
RFC 9110 Section 9.3.3 describes POST as a method for sending information to be processed, which is inconsistent with the definition of a safe method.
The HTTP standard issued in June 2022 (RFC 9110) does not classify POST as a safe method, directly contradicting the assertion.
